programs.name: Wildlife Ambassador Visits
programs.shortDesc: Noodle the crow visits K–12 classrooms, nature centers, and community events.
programs.longDesc: Our signature program brings Noodle the American Crow directly to your school or organization. Students get to meet a real wildlife ambassador, learn about imprinting and non-releasable animals, and discover what it means to be a steward of Michigan wildlife.

programs.name: Wildlife First Responder
programs.shortDesc: A community training program teaching people what to do — and what not to do — when they encounter injured wildlife.
programs.longDesc: Most wildlife emergencies are made worse by well-meaning people doing the wrong thing. Wildlife First Responder gives ordinary Michiganders the knowledge and confidence to be the first line of help — understanding when to act, when to wait, and who to call.

programs.name: Wildlife Transporter Network
programs.shortDesc: A volunteer driver network connecting injured animals to licensed rehabbers faster.
programs.longDesc: One of the biggest gaps in wildlife rescue is transport — rehabbers are often overloaded and miles away. We're building a network of trained volunteer drivers in Ottawa County and surrounding areas who can safely move animals from point of rescue to point of care.
requirements: Willingness to handle secure containment carriers

programs.name: Partner & Org Education
programs.shortDesc: Custom educational content for parks, conservation orgs, veterinary clinics, and nature centers.
programs.longDesc: We work with organizations that regularly encounter wildlife questions from the public — helping their staff and volunteers give accurate, helpful guidance instead of well-intentioned misinformation.
